issues.title: Broken Cross-References to External Workflows
issues.why: The spec references files like '../12-cicd-pipeline-workflows/02-release-pipeline.md' and 'linter-scripts/check-spec-cross-links.py' which are not provided in the context, making it impossible for an AI to verify the full pipeline logic.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the referenced workflow and script files or inline the critical logic into the generic-release module.

issues.title: Truncated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The AC-11 and subsequent criteria in 97-acceptance-criteria.md are cut off mid-sentence due to the context cap, leaving the 'Verifies' clauses for the installer contract incomplete.
issues.fix: Ensure the full text of the acceptance criteria document is included within the context limits.

issues.title: Ambiguous Error Handling for Checksum Mismatch
issues.why: While scripts show 'exit 1', the spec doesn't define specific error codes for different failure modes (e.g., network vs checksum vs arch mismatch) as required by D1/D3.
issues.fix: Enumerate specific exit codes (e.g., 10=Network, 11=Checksum, 12=Arch) in the installer contract.
